import re

def count_valid_words(text, max_length):
    # Use regex to find all words in the text
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text)
    # Count words that are within the max_length
    valid_word_count = sum(1 for word in words if len(word) <= max_length)
    return valid_word_count

def timed_reading(max_length, text):
    # Normalize the text to lowercase to ensure case-insensitivity
    normalized_text = text.lower()
    # Calculate and return the number of valid words
    return count_valid_words(normalized_text, max_length)

    # Calculate the number of days and remaining minutes

    remaining_minutes = mins % 1440
    # Calculate the starting day (Sunday)
    start_day = datetime.date.today().weekday()
    # Calculate the current day of the week
    current_day = (start_day + days) % 7
    # Map the day number to the day name
    days_of_week = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]

    # Calculate the current time in minutes since Sunday midnight
    current_minute = (datetime.now().hour * 60) + datetime.now().minute
    # Adjust the current time by the input minutes
    adjusted_minute = (current_minute + mins) % 1440
    # Calculate the number of days and remaining minutes
    days = adjusted_minute // 1440
    remaining_minutes = adjusted_minute % 1440
    # Determine the day of the week
    days_of_week = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]

    # Calculate the time in 24hr format

    minute = remaining_minutes % 60
    time = f"{hour:02}:{minute:02}"
    return day, time
